summary.en: Security officials were killed near Iran’s critical Chabahar port, raising cross-border tensions. Pakistan imposed emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, a step that could affect its relationship with Afghanistan. Afghanistan’s planned road to China remains stalled, limiting regional connectivity. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsoffiserer ble drept i nærheten av Irans kritiske havn Chabahar, noe som øker spenningene over grensen. Pakistan innførte nødtilstand i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, et steg som kan påvirke forholdet til Afghanistan. Afghanistans planlagte vei til Kina forblir stående, noe som begrenser regional tilknytning. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
